newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila plans to limit 100-year bond at $250 mln.
newsitem.headline: Manila plans to limit 100-year bond at $250 mln.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank is planning to limit the float of its 100-year global bond to $250 million, Central Bank governor Gabriel Singson said on Thursday.
The remaining $500 million to $750 million would be set aside for bonds with a 30-year maturity, he told reporters.
Singson said the small 100-year bond float will be enough to test its viability in the international market. The bank has the option to increase the issue if demand exceeds supply, he added.
He said the objective of the issue was not to raise funds but to set a longer-term benchamrk for subsequent state-owned and private sector borrowers.
The central bank announced earlier this month that Salomon Brothers would be the lead underwriter for the issue.
